summary.text: Lance Byrd is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 23-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Greg Nance (D).
An information technology professional, he was the Republican candidate for Washington State Senate District 23 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Lance Byrd graduated from Ballard High School and earned an associate degree from North Seattle College in 1995.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as an information technology professional.
In his 2026 survey answers, he described himself as raised in North Seattle and living in Kitsap County with his wife, with three children.
In the 2024 general election for Washington State Senate District 23, Byrd lost to incumbent Drew Hansen (D), 35.7 percent to 64.2 percent.
In his survey answers, Byrd described himself as a fiscal conservative and said he supports accountable budgeting based on population and inflation.
